purpose: WY v1 visual + NHD High Resolution checks of agency pins (research only; not read by the app). The NHDPlus_HR and nhd MapServers on hydro.nationalmap.gov returned HTTP 504 / 120 s timeouts on 2026-10-27, so the USGS NHD High Resolution HU4 GeoPackages (TNM staged products; the flowline network NHDPlus HR is built from) were downloaded and queried locally for the 150 m rule.
flowlineService: USGS NHD High Resolution HU4 GeoPackages (NHDFlowline), see research/raw/geo_cache/nhd_hr_gpkg_sources.json
method: Distance = nearest segment of the named-river NHD HR NHDFlowline (HU4 GeoPackage) to the pin, local equirectangular metres. Bank = side of the digitised centreline relative to its flow direction. NHDArea = StreamRiver polygons; pin inside polygon means it plots in the mapped channel.
